div.ab: XL. Heafodwunde to bote, gif ða ban butu beoð ðyrle, gesylle XXX scll' him mon.
XL. Heafodwunde to bote, gif ða ban beoð butu ðyrel, XXX scill. geselle him mon.
Capitis uulnus, si utrumque os perforatum sit, triginta solid. emendetur.
{XL} Heafodwunde to bote, gif ða ban beoð butu ðyrel, XXX scill geselle him mon.
As compensation for a headwound, if both bones are pierced, let him be paid 30 shillings.
30 shillings shall be given as compensation for a wound on the head, if both bones are pierced.
Einer Kopfwunde zur Busse, wenn die Knochen beide durch sind: 30 Schill. gebe man dem [Verletzten].
As compensation for a head-wound, if both bones are pierced: let 30 shillings be given to [the injured man].

note.label: compare
note.quote: This concordance provides solid evidence that Alfred did, in fact, know the laws of Æthelberht. (See Oliver 2010, and compare Æthelberht §36.)
